# sleep-aur 3.1.4

## Improvements

- The installer detects an existing sleep-aur installation.
- When the installed version matches the target, it exits without downloading or changing anything.
- Otherwise, it reports the update and installs the new version.
- Version comparison supports `v` prefixes, pre-releases, epochs, pkgrel, and numeric revisions.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/the-sleepless/sleep-aur/compare/v3.1.3...v3.1.4
